neighbours.label: Verbs of deploying or fielding forces and assets into action (deployed, field an army, sent out, deployment), vs the same subjects doing something that does not send them out
fire: The alliance deployed fighter jets to the eastern airbase.
The rebels were able to field nearly ten thousand soldiers.
Commanders sent out scouts before the main column advanced.
The country is deploying warships to protect its fishing fleet.
The rapid deployment of peacekeepers calmed the region.
The fire service deployed six crews to fight the wildfire.
Engineers deployed the update to every server overnight.
The general dispatched two regiments to hold the bridge.
quiet: The alliance retired its oldest fighter jets at the eastern airbase.
The rebels were able to feed nearly ten thousand soldiers.
Commanders praised the scouts after the main column advanced.
The country is building warships in its northern shipyards.
The slow training of peacekeepers worried the region.
The fire service thanked six crews for their work on the wildfire.
Engineers tested the update on one server overnight.
The general inspected two regiments near the bridge.
